ask: Resolve every ship to a model, by hand, with no fuzzy matching. C1 task of 2026-08-22.

files.table1_orphan_files.json: one row per .glb that no ship references - 40 rows
files.table2_ships_without_model.json: one row per ship rendering nothing - 115 rows
files.table3_fankit.json: the Fan Kit's 14 .ctm, and which fill a gap

method.automatic: exact normalised name, then ClassName, then stop. NO fuzzy matching.
method.by_hand: rows marked by=hand were judged individually. Every hand pair is named in the finding with the reason it was not caught automatically.
method.manufacturer_check: every claimed pair was checked against the ship's manufacturer field independently of the name.

what_this_is_NOT: Not a build input yet. Table 2's SHARED_HULL rows assert that an edition shares its base hull; that follows the 2026-08-14 shared-hull ruling but no ship was compared visually in game.
